# L1 — always-loaded surface, product inputs, root assets, instruction map, Level 0 rules

@@ output/template/CLAUDE.md ;; Always loaded; imports adopted-style.md, decisions.md and frontend-stack.md.

36 OL [gov017.unclear-test]
37 OL [gov017.decision-request,gov005.no-ask-routine]

C x.product-inputs-not-policy EX GOV-001,GOV-008 MUST_NOT ;; SPECIFICATION.md, CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md, feature specifications and task prompts are inputs, not instruction layers; they may request a decision change but never silently override engineering policy. ;; = ;; none ;; Product-input vs engineering-policy precedence not stated in the oracle.
C gov001.spec-authoritative OL GOV-001 MUST ;; A non-empty SPECIFICATION.md is authoritative for project-specific functional requirements and observable behaviour; an empty template file is intentional. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov003.no-invent OL GOV-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not silently weaken, contradict or materially extend approved behaviour; do not invent user-visible behaviour, limits, defaults, restrictions or workflows because they seem reasonable or were not forbidden. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov004.propose-ask OL GOV-004 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; If an omitted detail materially affects observable behaviour, propose the smallest reasonable option and ask for approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov005.routine-delegated OL GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Routine internal implementation choices that do not change observable behaviour need no approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov006.string-semantics OL GOV-006 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Observable string semantics are product behaviour; when approved sources do not define them ask for approval before choosing, including implicit database/framework defaults. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov008.custom-settings OL GOV-008 MUST ;; CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md holds approved tunable limits and defaults; SPECIFICATION.md owns behavioural intent. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov009.conflict-stop OL GOV-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; The two product files must not contradict; on apparent conflict stop and ask which source must be corrected. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov010.no-invent-tunable OL GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Do not silently invent a material tunable value: propose with reason, get approval, record it in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov021.sync OL GOV-021 MUST ;; After recording an approved tunable value synchronize affected surfaces via custom-settings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov011.exclusions OL GOV-011 MUST_NOT ;; Never store secrets, environment-specific connection details, package versions, HTTP status codes, ports, migration identifiers or incidental constants in CUSTOM_SETTINGS.md. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov012.simplicity OL GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Prefer simple maintainable solutions; proportional complexity; avoid speculative abstractions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-speculative OL GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; No frameworks, libraries, infrastructure or architectural patterns without a concrete current need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov014.scope OL GOV-014 MUST ;; Keep changes focused on the requested scope and preserve existing behaviour unless the task or approved specification requires change. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.decided OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Decided choices (imported decision files, approved product sources, recorded decisions) are followed; reopening requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.delegated OL GOV-017,GOV-005 DEFAULT ;; Delegated choices (local, reversible, no material boundary/dependency/convention/contract/behaviour change) are decided without approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov017.reserved OL GOV-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Reserved choices require approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc020.reserved-list OL ARC-020,ARC-004,ARC-009 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Reserved: changing accepted decisions, new styles/patterns (Rich Domain/DDD, CQRS, mediator, VSA, event sourcing, project-wide Result, microservices), new production projects/layers, persistence boundary/technology changes, messaging/background/distributed cache, replacing baseline technology, auth architecture changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-refgraph EX ARC-020,ARC-001 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing the project reference graph is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Not gated by ARC-020.
C x.reserved-infra-extra EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding search, external storage or external identity infrastructure is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Beyond ARC-020's list.
C x.reserved-major-lib EX DEP-001,GOV-013 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adding a major library/framework is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; The oracle requires current need, not approval.
C x.reserved-convention EX ARC-020 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Introducing any project-wide convention or abstraction is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; Generalizes ARC-020's Result example.
C api014.breaking-reserved OL API-014 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; A breaking public API change requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-versioning EX API-013,DEP-017 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Adopting API versioning is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;; API-013 requires a concrete need, not approval.
C gov004.reserved-product OL GOV-004,GOV-010 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Defining product behaviour or tunable values not defined by product sources is Reserved. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.reserved-selection-adr EX ARC-020,DEP-002 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; Changing a capability selection is Reserved and also requires an ADR (recorded with architecture-decision). ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-selection gate and ADR obligation not in the oracle.
C gov017.unclear-test OL GOV-017 MUST ;; Unclear case: any 'yes' to the five questions (dependency/framework/infrastructure, boundary, convention, observable behaviour/contract, expensive to reverse) makes it Reserved. ;; = ;; Unclear cases. ;;
C gov017.decision-request OL GOV-017 MUST ;; For a Reserved decision send a Decision Request (Context, Options, Recommendation, Blocked, Proceeding with) and continue only with non-Reserved work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov005.no-ask-routine OL GOV-005,GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; Do not ask for approval for routine choices already constrained by the specification, approved stack, existing code or rules. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.instruction-as-approval EX GOV-017,GOV-007 MUST ;; An explicit user instruction counts as approval; the accepted decision must be recorded with architecture-decision. ;; = ;; none ;; Recording obligation added to GOV-017.
C gov017.headless OL GOV-017 MUST_NOT ;; In autonomous/headless runs take only a policy-compliant non-Reserved path and report unresolved Decision Requests explicitly. ;; autonomous or headless runs ;; none ;;
C gov018.challenge OL GOV-018 MUST ;; Before implementing a questionable request name the concrete concerns and propose an alternative; never silently rewrite or ignore the requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.route-dev-workflow OL WF-001,WF-003 MUST ;; Any implementation work (incl. CI/CD or deployment changes) runs development-workflow; work is not complete until its verify step has run. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov015.git-explicit OL GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not commit, push, merge, rebase, reset, force-push, delete branches or perform other repository-changing Git operations unless explicitly requested. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov016.parallel OL GOV-016 MUST ;; Parallel implementation work uses separate branches or worktrees; unrelated changes stay out of the current branch. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.level-dependency EX - ENFORCED ;; Conformance dependencies point only to the same or a more stable level (0-core → 1-architecture → 2-technology → 3-project). ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-architecture invariant (repo/meta), checked by check-instructions.mjs.
C x.level-neutrality EX - ENFORCED ;; Core and Architecture name no concrete implementation technology in any form, pure pointers included; fixed vocabulary is .NET, C#, TypeScript, Git and HTTP; Level 2 is referenced only by role, capability, facet or technology-neutral skill name. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta invariant, checked by check-instructions.mjs.
C x.rule-placement-levels EX - MUST ;; Place content by stability: operating policy/neutral principles in 0-core, role vocabulary/boundaries in 1-architecture, concrete technique/bindings in 2-technology, selection/defaults/layout in 3-project. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta placement rule.
C x.cap-slots EX - MUST ;; Only four replaceable capability slots exist (architecture frame, persistence, backend-testing, optional frontend); module-owned artifacts declare Capability and appear in their MODULE.md. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system rule (repo/meta).
C x.headers EX - ENFORCED ;; Each artifact starts with a one-line header (Level, optional Capability/Facet, Owns, Scope, Loading). ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta invariant.
C x.run-checker-after-change EX - MUST ;; Run check-instructions.mjs after any instruction-system change. ;; = ;; none ;; Repo/meta rule.
C x.selection-naming EX - MUST_NOT ;; Outside modules, implementations are named only in the capability selection record of decisions.md (and the map). ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system rule (repo/meta).

C dep002.approved-first OL DEP-002,ARC-020 MUST ;; When an approved technology exists use it rather than silently selecting an alternative; replacing it is Reserved (record with architecture-decision). ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep008.platform OL DEP-008,ARC-010 DECIDED ;; .NET 10 LTS (latest stable servicing), C# 14, ASP.NET Core, Controllers; moving to preview/RC requires approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep010.fv-logging OL DEP-010 DECIDED ;; FluentValidation is the standard explicit validation library; logging via ILogger<T> with Serilog as provider. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep012.swagger OL DEP-012,API-017 DECIDED ;; Swashbuckle Swagger UI is the Development documentation/manual-testing surface (/swagger); outside Development only when deployment requirements justify it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep011.mapping-resilience OL DEP-011 DEFAULT ;; Manual mapping for simple cases; Mapster when mapping volume warrants it; Microsoft resilience packages only for real integration needs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep022.slnx OL DEP-022 DEFAULT ;; .slnx by default; legacy .sln only when an external tool or requirement needs it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep023.shared OL DEP-023 DEFAULT ;; Repository-level Directory.Build.props for shared build settings and Directory.Packages.props for CPM; project-specific settings stay in projects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep024.layout OL DEP-024 DEFAULT ;; Keep backend projects (backend/<Name>.<Layer>/), frontend workspace (frontend/<Name>.Web/) and docs/ separated; never a separate top-level tests directory. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep018.docker OL DEP-018 MUST_NOT ;; Do not introduce Docker merely because the app can be containerized; add container artifacts only when needed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cap-static-composition EX - MUST ;; Static composition: each required slot has exactly one selected implementation, the optional slot zero or one; only selected modules ship. ;; = ;; none ;; Capability-system rule (repo/meta).
C dep009.ef-sqlserver OL DEP-009,ARC-019,ARC-008,PST-004 DECIDED ;; Persistence: EF Core with Microsoft SQL Server (provider variant sqlserver); provider-specific concerns stay out of the use-case layer and domain model; EF Core migrations; Development-only seeder. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov006.collation-approval OL GOV-006 REQUIRES_APPROVAL ;; The default string comparison is the database default collation (typically case-insensitive); relying on it for observable behaviour needs approval. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep013.test-stack OL DEP-013,TST-001,TST-006 DECIDED ;; NUnit; backend test projects under backend/ beside production projects; WebApplicationFactory<Program> integration baseline; Testcontainers conditional. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/0-core/security.md ;; Path rule (**/*).
@scope path rule: **/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter paths.
6 NN ;; Banner.
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Heading.
12 OL [sec001.no-secrets]
13 OL [sec002.mechanisms]
15 NN ;; Heading.
17 OL [sec003.untrusted]
18 OL [sec004.parameterized]
19 OL [sec015.upload-metadata]
21 NN ;; Heading.
23 OL [sec005.server-authz]
24 OL [sec006.anonymous]
25 OL [sec016.platform-auth]
26 OL [sec017.token-validation]
27 OL [sec018.enumeration]
28 OL [sec011.csrf]
29 OL [sec012.token-storage]
31 NN ;; Heading.
33 OL [sec007.tls]
34 OL [sec009.cors]
35 OL [sec008.crypto]
37 NN ;; Heading.
39 OL [sec010.no-sensitive-logs]
40 OL [run014.no-payloads]
42 NN ;; Heading.
44 OL [sec013.fail-safe]
45 OL [sec014.visible-failure]
47 NN ;; Pointers.

C sec001.no-secrets OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Never hardcode/commit real secrets, credentials, private keys, tokens or production connection strings, including example or Development configuration. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec002.mechanisms OL SEC-002 DEFAULT ;; Local secret mechanism in development, environment injection or managed store in deployments; no unchosen cloud provider assumed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec003.untrusted OL SEC-003 MUST ;; Treat data crossing the trusted boundary as untrusted and validate it at the owning layer where assumptions matter. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec004.parameterized OL SEC-004 MUST ;; Parameterized database access; never concatenate untrusted input into SQL. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec015.upload-metadata OL SEC-015 MUST_NOT ;; Do not trust client file metadata such as MIME type as authoritative. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec005.server-authz OL SEC-005 MUST ;; Enforce authorization on the server; guards, hidden/disabled buttons and client checks are UX. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.anonymous OL SEC-006 MUST ;; Anonymous access is deliberate and visible; avoid redundant attributes under a secure global/fallback policy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec016.platform-auth OL SEC-016 MUST_NOT ;; No custom token/password security, hashing or reset-token cryptography when platform facilities cover the requirement. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec017.token-validation OL SEC-017 MUST ;; Validate what the issuer requires for Bearer/OIDC; never disable validation to make a token work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec018.enumeration OL SEC-018 MUST_NOT ;; No authentication-failure detail revealing secrets/account state; avoid enumeration leaks. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec011.csrf OL SEC-011 MUST ;; With automatic cookie credentials include CSRF protection; the frontend framework does not remove the risk. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec012.token-storage OL SEC-012 MUST_NOT ;; No browser token storage is universally secure; choose by threat model; tokens are never logged. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec007.tls OL SEC-007 MUST ;; Production sensitive traffic uses TLS respecting hosting topology; never disable certificate validation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec009.cors OL SEC-009 DEFAULT ;; Narrowest CORS policy for actual browser clients; never credentialed requests with unrestricted origins. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec008.crypto OL SEC-008 MUST_NOT ;; No custom cryptography when a reviewed platform mechanism fits; the payload-protection API is not universal database encryption. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec010.no-sensitive-logs OL SEC-010 MUST_NOT ;; Never log passwords, tokens, private keys, auth secrets or full payment credentials; avoid PII without permitted need; log level is not a privacy control. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run014.no-payloads OL RUN-014 MUST_NOT ;; Do not serialize arbitrary request bodies, domain objects or sensitive payloads into logs by default. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec013.fail-safe OL SEC-013 DEFAULT ;; Security-sensitive checks fail safely; never silently convert lookup/configuration failures into success. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec014.visible-failure OL SEC-014 MUST ;; Prefer visible startup/configuration failure over insecure fallback for required security controls. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/0-core/backend-code.md ;; Path rule (backend/**/*).
@scope path rule: backend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter paths.
6 NN ;; Banner.
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Heading.
12 OL [run001.clarity-first]
13 OL [run008.evidence]
14 OL [run006.efficient-db]

20 OL [run004.time-abstraction]
22 NN ;; Heading.

25 OL [run015.bounded]
26 OL [run016.safe-retry]
27 OL [run017.retry-after]
28 OL [run018.fallback]
29 OL [run019.cancel-not-transient]
31 NN ;; Heading.
33 OL [run007.need]
34 OL [run020.keys]
35 OL [run023.lifetime]
36 OL [run021.invalidation]
38 NN ;; Heading.
40 OL [run022.typed-options]
41 OL [arc021.constructor-injection]

43 OL [run013.structured]
45 NN ;; Heading.

49 OL [run011.no-style-rewrites]

C run001.clarity-first OL RUN-001 DEFAULT ;; Clear correct code first; specialized optimizations only for a concrete reason, preferring measurement for non-trivial ones. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.evidence OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Compiled queries, allocation-reducing return types, pooling, custom serialization, aggressive caching or raw SQL for performance only for a measured or demonstrated need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.efficient-db OL RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Filter/project in the database, avoid round trips, over-fetching and N+1, paginate large result sets. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run002.no-sync-over-async OL RUN-002 MUST_NOT ;; Use async APIs for asynchronous I/O and never block them with synchronous waits. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run003.cancellation OL RUN-003 MUST ;; Propagate cancellation tokens when meaningful; no cancellation parameters on purely synchronous code without a use case. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run004.time-abstraction OL RUN-004 DEFAULT ;; Use an injectable time abstraction for clock-dependent logic needing deterministic tests; do not mechanically replace stored timestamps. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run005.httpclient OL RUN-005 MUST_NOT ;; Never create and dispose an HTTP client per request; use a factory-managed or long-lived strategy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.bounded OL RUN-015 MUST ;; External I/O has bounded execution time; avoid overlapping unclear timeouts. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.safe-retry OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Retry only when safe; never automatically retry state-changing operations without idempotency or duplicate prevention. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run017.retry-after OL RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; Respect Retry-After or equivalent guidance; never retry indefinitely or aggressively. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run018.fallback OL RUN-018 MUST ;; Fallback only when semantically acceptable; never hide correctness failures behind defaults. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run019.cancel-not-transient OL RUN-019 MUST_NOT ;; Caller cancellation is not a transient failure; never retry it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run007.need OL RUN-007 DEFAULT ;; Caching is not a default requirement; only for a clear need; implementation chosen by deployment, consistency and staleness. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run020.keys OL RUN-020 MUST ;; Cache keys uniquely represent the value incl. user, tenant, locale and query dimensions; no global keys for user/tenant data. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run023.lifetime OL RUN-023 MUST ;; Every cache entry has a lifetime or explicit invalidation strategy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run021.invalidation OL RUN-021 MUST ;; Invalidate/update cache only consistently with successful mutations; the cache is never a second source of truth. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run022.typed-options OL RUN-022 DEFAULT ;; Strongly typed options validated at startup when invalid values prevent correct/secure operation; avoid scattered string lookups. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc021.constructor-injection OL ARC-021 DEFAULT ;; Constructor injection for required dependencies; avoid service locator and property injection. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.lifetimes OL ARC-022 MUST_NOT ;; Never capture a shorter-lived dependency inside a longer-lived service. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run013.structured OL RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Log through the injected abstraction with structured templates and stable property names; avoid interpolation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run009.conventions OL RUN-009 DEFAULT ;; Follow repository conventions and .editorconfig; modern C# when clearer; no mechanical modernization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run024.file-naming OL RUN-024 DEFAULT ;; New code: file-scoped namespaces when consistent, one primary type per matching file, Async suffix for awaitable methods unless a contract prevents it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run011.no-style-rewrites OL RUN-011 MUST_NOT ;; No style-only rewrites outside the requested change unless explicitly asked. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/0-core/http-api.md ;; Path rule (backend/**/*).
@scope path rule: backend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter paths.
6 NN ;; Banner.
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 NN ;; Heading.
12 OL [api002.problem-details]
13 OL [api003.success-statuses]
14 OL [api004.empty-collection]
15 OL [api005.auth-statuses]
16 OL [api006.conflict-precondition]
18 IM ;; Pointer to the http-api skill.
20 NN ;; Heading.
22 OL [api007.central]
23 OL [api008.no-leak]
24 OL [api011.no-exception-flow]
25 OL [api012.log-once]
26 OL [api021.cancel-not-500]
28 NN ;; Heading.
30 OL [api013.need]
31 OL [api014.breaking]
32 OL [api015.strategy]
34 NN ;; Heading.
36 OL [api018.cheap]
37 OL [api019.liveness-readiness]
38 OL [api020.health-exposure]

C api002.problem-details OL API-002 DEFAULT ;; Problem-details (RFC 9457) for non-validation failures and validation problem-details for request validation; stable safe machine-readable contracts. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.success-statuses OL API-003 MUST ;; Choose 200/201/202/204 by actual semantics; never 200 for everything, 201 for an internal insert or 202 for completed work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api004.empty-collection OL API-004 DEFAULT ;; A successful zero-match collection query returns 200 with an empty collection, not 404. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.auth-statuses OL API-005 MUST ;; 401 for missing/failed authentication, 403 for not permitted; 404 hiding needs a deliberate consistent policy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.conflict-precondition OL API-006 MUST ;; 409 for valid requests conflicting with state; 412 when an explicit precondition such as If-Match fails. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api007.central OL API-007 DEFAULT ;; Unexpected failures propagate to one centralized exception-handling boundary; avoid repetitive catch/log/rethrow. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api008.no-leak OL API-008 MUST_NOT ;; Never expose stack traces, SQL, connection strings, internal paths, secrets or sensitive exception details in public errors. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api011.no-exception-flow OL API-011 MUST_NOT ;; No business exceptions as the default architecture; no throw/catch between normal expected branches. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api012.log-once OL API-012 MUST ;; Log an unexpected exception once at the handling boundary. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api021.cancel-not-500 OL API-021 MUST_NOT ;; Normal client cancellation is not a server failure: never a generic 500 or unhandled-error log. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api013.need OL API-013 MUST_NOT ;; No API versioning merely because an API exists; add it for a concrete compatibility need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api014.breaking OL API-014 MUST ;; Once relied on externally avoid silent breaking changes; a breaking change requires a new version or approved compatibility strategy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api015.strategy OL API-015 DEFAULT ;; One versioning strategy consistently; URL-segment unless requirements justify another. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api018.cheap OL API-018 MUST ;; Health checks stay cheap and deterministic; never business workflows, expensive queries or mutating database work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api019.liveness-readiness OL API-019 MUST ;; Liveness avoids external dependencies whose outage could cause restart loops; readiness may depend on required capabilities and reflects startup/dependency availability. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api020.health-exposure OL API-020 MUST_NOT ;; Public health responses must not expose secrets, credentials, connection details, stack traces or unnecessary diagnostics. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/0-core/testing.md ;; Path rule (backend test projects).
@scope path rule: backend/**/*Tests/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter paths.
6 NN ;; Banner.
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 OL [tst002.narrowest]
11 OL [tst003.behavior]
12 OL [tst004.isolation]
13 OL [tst005.explicit]
14 OL [tst006.integration]
15 OL [tst007.provider-fidelity]
16 OL [tst008.known-state]
17 OL [tst011.coverage]
18 OL [tst012.descriptive]
20 IM ;; Pointers to the framework facet and knowledge skill.

C tst002.narrowest OL TST-002 DEFAULT ;; Narrowest meaningful test level; integration tests when wiring, HTTP, persistence, serialization, authentication or interaction is the subject; no fixed ratio. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst003.behavior OL TST-003 MUST ;; Test observable behaviour that survives refactoring; no private-call/incidental-sequence assertions or reproduced algorithms; interaction checks only when the interaction is specified behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst004.isolation OL TST-004,RUN-004 MUST ;; Tests are deterministic, order-independent and isolated from Production/Development data, uncontrolled systems, shared mutable state and wall-clock timing where an injectable time abstraction can make time deterministic. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst005.explicit OL TST-005 DEFAULT ;; Explicit declarative cases for small finite input spaces; state expected results instead of computing them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst006.integration OL TST-006 DEFAULT ;; In-process host integration tests when routing, binding, middleware, authentication, DI, repositories, ORM or persistence is the subject. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst007.provider-fidelity OL TST-007 DEFAULT ;; Actual provider when relational/provider behaviour matters (real-provider containers optional); never claim fidelity from a different provider. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst008.known-state OL TST-008 MUST ;; Tests start from a known state and own their setup; never depend on development seed data or test order. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst011.coverage OL TST-011 MUST_NOT ;; Do not generate low-value tests merely to raise coverage. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst012.descriptive OL TST-012 DEFAULT ;; Descriptive scenario/condition/expected-behaviour names (e.g. MethodOrScenario_Condition_ExpectedBehavior); follow an established convention. ;; = ;; none ;;

@@ output/template/.claude/rules/0-core/frontend.md ;; Path rule (frontend/**/*).
@scope path rule: frontend/**/*
1-4 IM ;; Frontmatter paths.
6 NN ;; Banner.
8 NN ;; Heading.
10 OL [fe002.presentation]
11 OL [fe003.http-boundary]
12 OL [fe007.feature-oriented]
13 OL [fe005.lazy]
14 OL [fe006.simple-state]
15 OL [fe009.error-contract]
16 OL [fe010.forms-validation]
18 IM ;; Pointers to the framework facet and security rules.

C fe002.presentation OL FE-002 MUST ;; Pages/components focus on presentation and UI orchestration; no trivial presentation logic moved into services to shrink components. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe003.http-boundary OL FE-003 MUST ;; Backend communication in explicit feature data-access services; no scattered HTTP calls; never import backend domain/persistence types. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe007.feature-oriented OL FE-007,FE-001 MUST ;; Feature-oriented structure; no application-wide technical buckets or empty folders; feature code in its feature; small core/shared. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe005.lazy OL FE-005 DEFAULT ;; Route-level lazy loading for meaningful features, not every tiny component. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe006.simple-state OL FE-006 DEFAULT ;; Prefer simple local/component/service state before a state-management library. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe009.error-contract OL FE-009 MUST ;; Follow the documented API error contract; centralize problem-details parsing when practical; never infer behaviour from human-readable messages. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe010.forms-validation OL FE-010 MUST ;; Reactive forms for non-trivial forms when useful; frontend validation never replaces backend validation or integrity/security enforcement. ;; = ;; none ;;
